subject: Scheduling: OrionAI security review & runbook walk-through
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Cruz <a.cruz@orionai.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: OrionAI security review & runbook walk-through

Alexandra —

Thanks for the quick demo interest last week. Customer success suggested we schedule a focused security review so your security and infra teams can validate data flows and controls before the POC. Proposed attendees: you (security/infra), someone from procurement for contract Qs, our SE (Soojin Lee) to walk architecture, and our Security Engineer (Mina Haddad) to cover compliance artifacts.

Can you share 2–3 60-minute windows next week that work for your team? We can timebox to 60 minutes (30m review + 30m Q&A) and follow up with any deep-dive sessions if needed.

I attached the SOC2 highlights and our network diagram for context. If there are specific artifacts your team needs in advance (ingress/egress IPs, retention policy), call them out and Mina will attach.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: SOC2-summary-2027.pdf (summary), redwood-network-diagram.png (high-level)

From: Alexandra Cruz <a.cruz@orionai.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@orionai.com, procurement@orionai.com
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling: OrionAI security review & runbook walk-through

Jonas —

Thanks for the materials, that helps. Our security lead (cc’d) is out Thu/Fri this week, but available Mon/Tue next week. Procurement would like to sit in for the first 15 minutes to confirm the data classification and contractual controls.

Available windows (PT):
- Mon Jul 9: 09:30–10:30 or 14:00–15:00
- Tue Jul 10: 11:00–12:00

We prefer a recorded Zoom meeting and an agenda indicating artifacts you’ll present. Also can you share any required Non-Disclosure language up front?

- Alex
Alexandra Cruz
Sr. Cloud Security Engineer | OrionAI
a.cruz@orionai.com

Subject: Re: Scheduling: OrionAI security review & runbook walk-through

Jonas / Soojin —

Thanks for looping me in. A couple of notes for the session so we make it efficient:
- Session length: 60 minutes recommended (30m technical walk-through + 30m Q&A).
- Required pre-reads: SOC2 summary (already attached), encryption-at-rest overview, retention policy doc. I can upload the last two if you give me a list of fields the customer cares about.
- Artifacts I will bring: SOC2 attestations, data flow diagram, RBAC overview, and our external penetration test summary.
- Attendee ask: Please include one infrastructure or platform engineer from Orion who can answer network/topology questions. Procurement can join for first 15 minutes.

I’ll also prepare a short checklist table (controls vs evidence) to send 24 hours before the meeting.

Mina Haddad
Security Engineer, Compliance | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Cruz <a.cruz@orionai.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling: OrionAI security review & runbook walk-through

Alexandra —

Thanks — happy to lead the architecture portion. If we do Mon Jul 9, we can cover: deployment topology, service-to-service auth, KV cache behavior during PII redaction, and our recommended quantization profiles for cost/latency. I’ll keep slides to 20 minutes so we leave plenty of Q&A.

For Zoom: do you have a corporate Zoom link we should use? If not I can create one and record.

Also: procurement, any documents you want shared beforehand? We typically include our DPA and a short NDA template — happy to send those now so your legal/procurement can review.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

All —

Thanks for the quick responses. Per availability, I’ve booked Mon Jul 9, 14:00–15:00 PT and added a 15-minute procurement slot at start (14:00–14:15). Invite attached and a Google Calendar link is below.

Agenda (high level):
- 14:00–14:15: Procurement overview (DPA & data classification)
- 14:15–14:35: Architecture & deployment walk (Soojin)
- 14:35–14:50: Compliance artifacts & controls mapping (Mina)

See you Monday,
Jonas
